programs.program: Local Food Promotion Program (LFPP), USDA AMS (LAMP)
programs.funds_what: Planning and implementation for intermediaries: aggregation, processing, distribution, storage, marketing. No land purchase or building construction.
programs.match_requirement: 25% of federal request, cash and/or in-kind, committed by selection
programs.cycle_deadline: FY2026 closed Jun 5, 2026 (~$13.84M). FY2027: no round expected until Congress restores LAMP funding; LAMP lost its budget baseline when the farm bill extension lapsed Sep 30, 2026 (per AgSist summary of CRS; confirm with AMS).

programs.program: Regional Food System Partnerships (RFSP), USDA AMS (LAMP)
programs.funds_what: Public-private partnerships to plan and build regional food systems, incl. shared cold storage and institutional market links

programs.cycle_deadline: FY2026 round ($4.71M) closed Jun 5, 2026. FY2027 tied to the same LAMP funding lapse.
programs.eligibility_notes: Hub applies as part of a partnership with producers, processors and institutional buyers

programs.program: Value-Added Producer Grant (VAPG), USDA RD
programs.funds_what: Planning (feasibility, business plans) or working capital: processing, packaging, marketing, inventory, salaries
programs.award_range: Planning up to $50K; Working capital up to $200K
programs.cycle_deadline: FY2026 closed Apr 22, 2026 (~$25M available; $26M+ awarded Sep 18, 2026). FY2027 notice not posted as of Nov 22, 2026; window is usually Jan–May.
programs.eligibility_notes: Producers, producer groups, farmer co-ops and majority producer-controlled businesses only. Most nonprofit or investor-owned hubs do not qualify.

programs.program: Rural Business Development Grant (RBDG), USDA RD
programs.funds_what: Technical assistance, training, feasibility studies, business plans, incubators, equipment and revolving loan funds benefiting small rural businesses
programs.cycle_deadline: FY2026 closed Jun 30, 2026 (SECD track Jun 15). FY2027 notice not yet posted.
programs.eligibility_notes: Public bodies, nonprofits and tribes; project must benefit areas outside cities of 50,000+. For-profit hubs cannot apply directly.

programs.program: Business & Industry (B&I) Loan Guarantee, USDA RD
programs.funds_what: Real estate, equipment, inventory, working capital, acquisitions. Not lines of credit.
programs.match_requirement: n/a (lender guarantee: 85% on loans up to $5M, 80% from $5M–25M in FY2026)
programs.cycle_deadline: Ongoing through lenders
programs.eligibility_notes: For-profits, co-ops, nonprofits with an operating business, tribes. Rural areas outside towns of 50,000+.

programs.program: Community Facilities Direct Loan & Grant, USDA RD

programs.award_range: Loans up to 40 years (4.500–4.750%, Apr–Sep 2026); grants up to 75% of project cost for the smallest, lowest-income communities
programs.match_requirement: Grant share scales with community size and income
programs.cycle_deadline: Rolling, year-round
programs.eligibility_notes: Public bodies, community-based nonprofits, tribes. Rural population cap not re-verified for this directory.

programs.program: Food Supply Chain Guaranteed Loan, USDA RD

programs.cycle_deadline: UNVERIFIED: current loan window not confirmed
